summary_en: KJ005 Co. announced progress toward launching a tender offer for Taiyo Holdings shares. As of October 9, 2026, regulatory approvals in Japan, Taiwan, Germany, Tunisia, and Vietnam, and U.S. investment clearance were completed. Pending approvals from China's competition law review and Japan's foreign investment regulations. Launch targeted for late November 2026.
title_en: Notice of Progress Toward Implementation of Tender Offer for Shares of Taiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: 4626) by KJ005 Co.
translation_en_brief:
KJ005 Co. issued a progress update on its tender offer for Taiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime Market, Code 4626) on October 9, 2026. The offeror announced that regulatory approvals and clearances required under antitrust laws and foreign investment regulations in multiple jurisdictions are being processed. As of the announcement date, necessary procedures under competition law in Japan, Taiwan, Germany, Tunisia, and Vietnam, and clearance under U.S. foreign investment regulations, had been completed. However, approvals from China's antitrust review and Japan's Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Control Act remained pending.

The offeror noted that initial expectations included obtaining pre-approval in Spain, Israel, and South Korea, but subsequent consultation with local legal counsel determined that Spain and Israel do not require pre-approval filings, while South Korea requires only post-transaction notification. These jurisdictions were accordingly removed from the pre-approval process. The offeror currently targets completion of all remaining regulatory procedures by end-November 2026 and aims to commence the tender offer in late November 2026, subject to satisfaction of all conditions to proceed. The announcement indicated that material changes to the expected launch timeline would be disclosed promptly.
